test_type: BUG-026, BUG-027, BUG-028 Bug Fix Verification
summary: All three bugs (BUG-026, BUG-027, BUG-028) have been verified as fixed. Raw Material Master correctly filters out sub-recipe items from Ingredients tab, Categories tab, and all category dropdowns. Consumption and Days of Stock calculations now use daily-consumption-report API and show reasonable values. Purchase Order Create correctly filters sub-recipes, has search field, renamed columns with tooltips, and 'Pick vendor' dropdown for items without vendor history.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: Ingredients tab - no sub-recipe items
features_tested.details: Ingredients tab shows only raw materials (Ajwain, Almonds, Baking Powder, etc.). No sub-recipe items like 'Ajwain Cookies With Jaggery' visible.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: Categories tab - no 'Sub Recipe' category
features_tested.details: Categories tab shows Cookie, coffee, Khari only. 'Sub Recipe' category is correctly hidden.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: Category filter dropdown - no 'Sub Recipe'
features_tested.details: Category filter dropdown shows: All Categories, Cookie, Khari, coffee. No 'Sub Recipe' option.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: Add Item category dropdown - no 'Sub Recipe'
features_tested.details: Add Item form category dropdown shows: Cookie, coffee, Khari. No 'Sub Recipe' option.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: 'Used In' column with recipe+sub-recipe count
features_tested.details: 'Used In' column visible with counts (e.g., Baking Soda: 3, Egg Replacer: 4). Tooltip explains it counts recipes + sub-recipes.

features_tested.feature: BUG-026: Categories tab - edit icon and toggle switch, no delete
features_tested.details: Each category row has edit icon (pencil) and active/inactive toggle switch. No delete buttons present.
Expanded ingredient rows show consumption from API. Baking Soda: 0.0 kg/day, GSM: 0.1 kg/day.

features_tested.feature: BUG-027: Days of Stock - reasonable values
features_tested.details: Days of Stock shows reasonable values. Baking Soda (3.32kg, 0 consumption): 262d. GSM (56.91kg, 0.1kg/day): 729d. No unreasonable values like '995d for 29kg'.

features_tested.feature: BUG-028: By Vendor mode - search field above table
features_tested.details: Search field with placeholder 'Search items...' present above the items table in By Vendor mode.

features_tested.feature: BUG-028: By Vendor mode - no sub-recipe items
features_tested.details: Items list shows only raw materials. No sub-recipe items visible.

features_tested.feature: BUG-028: By Item Need - no sub-recipe items
features_tested.details: By Item Need tab shows 44 total items, all raw materials. No sub-recipe contamination.

features_tested.feature: BUG-028: By Item Need - 'Daily Consumption' column
BUG-028: By Item Need - 'Days Will Last' column with tooltip
features_tested.details: Column renamed from 'Days' to 'Days Will Last' with info icon tooltip explaining calculation.

features_tested.feature: BUG-028: By Item Need - 'Pick vendor' dropdown
features_tested.details: Items without vendor history show 'Pick vendor' dropdown (with UserPlus icon) instead of 'No history' text.
Expected Rate column shows ₹0 for items without rate history as read-only text (not editable input). Items with history show actual rate (e.g., coffee beans: ₹500).
